title: The agent asks before it spends, and says roughly how much
description: Fabio, 2026-09-21: the in-app agent must not run a BILLED cloud model without a yes/no card first, and that card has to say in one short sentence roughly what it will cost. Today a cloud op just runs. The gate is the agent:confirm seam in services/agentLoop.mjs (kind install exists for a download, kind batch was added by MPI-870) plus _appendConfirm in MpiAgentChat.js; the PRICE comes from dev_configs/deepinfra-prices.json via deepinfraPricing.js. Composes with MPI-870's batch confirm: N cloud cards is ONE card naming N x the per-image price, never N cards. Depends on MPI-875 for the rank and the cost note; this card is the gate only, not the ranking. Under the MPI-817 agent-reliability umbrella. MERGED 2026-09-22: this card ABSORBS MPI-854 (MPI-849 phase 2), which was the same job written a day earlier under the other umbrella and is now done/rejected as a duplicate. Its implementation map lives in this card's plan.md - the gate site agentLoop.mjs:924 and why it cannot sit after the fire at :1004, the four paths that bypass an agentLoop-only gate (POST /connector/generate which has no consent gate by design, the user's own Cue press, the Flow branch where model.id is null, and crash-requeue which re-spends silently), the six edits including the GET /agent/history projection without which a reload loses the price while Yes still spends, and the tests/agent-no-delete.test.cjs trap. This card is now BOTH umbrellas' phase - report it to MPI-849 as well as MPI-817. The start gate is MPI-851 (validating), which ships the provider field the is-this-billed predicate reads.
